response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which permits returns of defective items regardless of the standard window. Although RET-008 would make the item ineligible for being past 30 days (44 days), RET-020 has higher priority (90 vs 10) and controls. RET-012 does not apply since the item is not final sale, and no fraud hold or goodwill grant is present.
